title: The Last Fakeout Before $126K Bitcoin 📈
alt_hooks: Did Bitcoin just trap every single bear at $15,000 before the massive run to $126,000?
How the brutal $15,000 crypto crash in 2022 tricked everyone into missing the $126,000 rally.
Is this current market dip the exact same fakeout we saw right before $126,000?

scenes.line: Everyone panicked when Bitcoin crashed to $15,000 in November 2022.
Exchange reserves dried up instantly as panic sellers dumped every single satoshi they owned.
Smart money quietly accumulated at the absolute bottom while mainstream media shouted that crypto was dead.
Then institutional spot ETFs launched in January 2024, injecting billions of fresh Wall Street dollars.
That exact fakeout catalyzed an explosive vertical rally straight past $126,000.
Look closely at the charts right now, because this current dip looks like the exact same trap.

description: When Bitcoin hit $15,000 in November 2022, most investors panicked and sold at the absolute bottom. That brutal fakeout set the stage for institutional ETF inflows and a massive rally all the way to $126,000. Are current market dips just another trap before the next leg up?
